tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Find market and macro data series on Global Macro Expert by keyword (e.g. "brent", "euribor", "german power", "copper", "gold positioning"). Returns ids with the latest value, date, unit and source.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: History of one series (id from search_series), optionally aggregated to W, M, Q or Y averages (period-end for rates). At most 400 points per call.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Platform tables: outlook (official forward price paths: EIA, ECB, IMF, World Bank), cot (CFTC long/short positioning), tradeflows (largest bilateral export flows and chokepoint traffic), geography (resources by country; give layer, e.g. copper_prod, lithium_res, oil_prod), dallasfed (US shale breake

tools.name: get_country_macro
tools.description: Latest macro indicators of an economy (IMF World Economic Outlook and World Bank): growth, inflation, unemployment, debt, current account, GDP, with IMF projections.

tools.name: search_releases
tools.description: Search official announcements of central banks, statistics offices, international organisations and regulators archived on Global Macro Expert.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_table" is 975 chars, far longer than this server's median (165). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
